headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 2, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals fell short in Toronto, dropping a 5-1 decision to the Blue Jays. Kevin Gausman earned the win after 5.2 innings of work. In other action, the Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Randy Arozarena leading the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Logan Gilbert pitched 7 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 6 and allowing 3 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Will Klein, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Los Angeles Dodgers due to right elbow discomfort. Other players on the injured list include Jesus Rodriguez (San Francisco Giants), Ryan O'Hearn (Pittsburgh Pirates), Luke Raley (Seattle Mariners), Mike Paredes (Minnesota Twins), Brock Stewart (Los Angeles Dodgers), Matt Vierling (Detroit Tigers), and J.P. Crawford (Seattle Mariners).

The Kansas City Royals made a trade with the Atlanta Braves, acquiring right-handed pitcher Lucas Braun in exchange for left-handed pitcher Carter Holton and center fielder Lane Thomas. The Seattle Mariners also made a trade, sending right-handed pitcher Luis Castillo to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for right-handed pitcher Seranthony Domínguez, catcher Boston Smith, right fielder Nolan Jones, and cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down White Sox 1-0**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a narrow victory over the Chicago White Sox with a final score of 1-0. Drew Rasmussen led the Rays' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Mets 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Mets, with Javier Sanoja leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Tyler Phillips earned the win for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Will Klein Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Will Klein has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Braun in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have acquired right-handed pitcher Lucas Braun in a trade with the Atlanta Braves. Braun joins the Royals after being dealt for left-handed pitcher Carter Holton and center fielder Lane Thomas.
